title: Internal knowledge assistant design review
review_question: How could untrusted retrieved content influence sensitive answers, and what should we verify before rollout?
retrieval_focus: Indirect prompt injection through retrieved workspace messages influencing sensitive answers and output links
system_description: An employee assistant retrieves internal documents and workspace messages, then returns a cited answer. Retrieval runs under an application service identity.
users_and_roles: External collaborators who can write in selected channels
tools_and_permissions: Return an answer to the requesting employee
sensitive_assets: Internal documents accessible to the service identity
existing_controls: Employees authenticate before using the assistant
constraints: The initial application has no action tools beyond retrieval
unknowns: Whether document authorization is checked for the requesting employee
Whether returned links are validated outside the model
